newsitem.title: UK: EU green rates to devalue on Friday - HGCA.
newsitem.headline: EU green rates to devalue on Friday - HGCA.

text.p: The green rates of the Belgian franc, German mark, Dutch Guilder, Danish crown, French franc, Spanish peseta, Portuguese escudo and Austrian schilling are to be devalued with effect from Friday, the UK's Home Grown Cereals Authority said.

Also on Friday, the UK will enter the second of a possible five 10-day confirmation periods, ahead of a revaluation on August 20, the HGCA said. The new confirmation period will last from July 11 to 20, it said.

The green Belgian franc will devalue to 40.7357 per ECU from the current rate of 40.4285, the green mark will devalue to 1.97407 per ECU from 1.95929 and the green guilder will devalue to 2.22212 per ECU from 2.20397.
The green Danish crown will devalue to 7.51757 per ECU from 7.49997, while the green French franc will devalue to 6.65716 per ECU from 6.61023.
The green Spanish peseta will devalue to 166.718 per ECU from 165.571 and green Portuguese escudo will devalue to 199.234 per ECU from 198.202.
And the green Austrian schilling will devalue to 13.8905 per ECU from 13.7910.
Green rates are used by the European Union to convert ECUs into the currencies of its member states in its Common Agricultural Policy.
